touchAssertions: Dialog remains entirely visible in portrait and landscape viewports.

qualificationLimits: Linux Playwright engines, not branded production browser binaries or manufacturer hardware.
Viewport rotation emulates width and height changes; it does not test physical orientation, sensor delivery, browser chrome or virtual keyboard.
Synthetic provider transport validates interface lifecycle, not real provider quality or latency.
The canonical offline import scenario explicitly resets the viewport to390x844.
The canonical offline restoration scenario opens a fresh secondary browser context without inheriting mobile emulation.
No local execution succeeded or failed because no local browser was started.
